question: The level of urbanisation in India is measured in terms of ________ of urban population to total population.
solution: The correct answer is __**percentage**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **The level of urbanisation** is measured in **terms of percentage of urban population to total population**. • **The level of urbanisation in India in 2011 was 31.16 per cent,** which is quite low in comparison to developed countries. • Total urban population has increased eleven-fold during the twentieth century. • Enlargement of urban centres and emergence of new towns have played a significant role in the growth of urban population and urbanisation in the country. • **But the growth rate of urbanisation has slowed down during the last two decades**.
